name: Fabric
description:
Fabric is a personal AI workspace where everything you save, write, capture, or record lives in one intelligent space. Notes, files, PDFs, bookmarks, voice recordings, meeting transcripts, web clippings, photos, and more – all searchable by meaning, not just keywords.

The Fabric MCP connector gives Claude direct access to your entire Fabric library. Ask Claude to search your notes, find a PDF you saved last month, pull up highlights from a book, or reference a meeting transcript – without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:

Search across everything in your Fabric library by meaning. Ask "what were my notes on pricing strategy" and get results from across notes, documents, bookmarks, and recordings.

Reference your own materials in conversations with Claude. Instead of pasting content manually, Claude can pull directly from your saved research, course materials, client files, or personal notes.

Build on your own knowledge. Claude's intelligence combined with your personal library means answers grounded in your actual work – not generic internet results.

Fabric connects to all your favourite apps and tools – Google Drive, email, Linear, Google Calendar, Slack, and more – which feed into the same searchable library that Claude can access.

Whether you're a student studying from lecture recordings and textbook PDFs, a researcher working across hundreds of papers, a freelancer managing client projects, or a founder keeping track of competitive research – Fabric gives Claude the context it needs to help you with your actual work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fabric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fabric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.fabric.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fabric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fabric lists 23 MCP tools, including fabric-apply-tag, fabric-copy-items, fabric-create-bookmark, fabric-create-folder, fabric-create-memory, fabric-create-note, fabric-create-tag, fabric-create-task, fabric-delete-item, fabric-delete-task, fabric-edit-memory, and fabric-edit-notepad.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fabric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fabric in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fabric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fabric is developed by Fabric. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
